name: cache
description: Bounded caching with pluggable eviction for boru, to be exposed as the single `Cache` namespace. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED: cache.aql exports an empty namespace. See DESIGN.md.

conventions.import: import "./cache.aql" — no `end` needed. A relative import resolves against the directory of the importing file (for both `boru X` and `boru check X`), not the working directory: a suite in test/ imports "../cache.aql".
conventions.call: forward args, receiver (the cache) LAST: `Cache.verb ...args c`. Piping `c Cache.verb ...args` binds identically. Receiver-first all-forward misbinds: with a typed receiver `boru check` rejects it (uncalled_function, which also blocks `boru X`); two same-typed args bind silently in signature order. Pass a function as data with `f/v` (a bare name holding a function calls; `/r` was renamed `/v`).
conventions.scope: An EFFECT MEMOIZER first: a cache only pays over work dearer than a lookup. Re-measured on boru main @ 64c5ab2 (compiled): a map read ~1-3us, a write ~2-4us, a cache-shaped lookup (call + hit-counter bump + entry read) ~10us — the design was argued from ~63us reads on the old interpreter (DESIGN.md section 2 note, bench/map_cost.aql). Caching work cheaper than ~10us makes the program slower. Wrap network calls, file reads and expensive parses.
conventions.keys: Cache keys are Strings: boru map keys must be String or Atom (a String and an Atom of the same text share a slot). Internally a computed key needs parens with `set` (`ent set (key) v`): `set` quotes a bare word, while `get`/`has` evaluate their key.
conventions.time: The library never reads the clock: if TTL lands, the caller supplies the timestamp. On boru main the gate that bites is the module-import gate (e.g. the gen profile refuses `import "boru:time-util"`), not the clock scope (DESIGN.md section 6 note).
conventions.memoize: No `memoize` word in v1, by scope rather than by defect: the free-word scope defect that once blocked it (design/FUNCTION-VALUE-SCOPE.0.md) is fixed upstream (boru 7e98aeb) and re-verified on main.
